With the passage and signing of the CHIPS and Science Act, our nation is once again leading in semiconductor manufacturing, solidifying our position as an economic and technological world power.

No one should have to empty their pocketbooks trying to afford medication.

Thanks to the Inflation Reduction Act, no senior on Medicare has to pay more than $35 for insulin. Let’s finish the job and make that the case for all Americans.

I agree with President Biden and Democrats that Social Security and Medicare should not be cut.

Good to hear a deal struck on national TV that the other side agrees cuts are off the table.

The #SandyHook shooting was so horrific, we couldn’t have imagined our nation going through a tragedy like that again. But in the decade since, there have been **948** school shootings.

Today on the 10th anniversary of that horrible day in Newtown, we must honor the victims with action to end senseless gun violence.

The result is a documentary film titled “Grit and Grace: The Fight for the American Dream”

Ten years later, the loss of twenty schoolchildren and six educators in Newtown, Connecticut continues to weigh heavy on our hearts. Each day, more communities are ravaged by shootings, more families are broken, and more lives are lost. We can and must do more. For the children and teachers of Sandy Hook Elementary, for the families of those we’ve lost, and for all those whose lives have been upended by this senseless violence, I will keep fighting.”

Last week I joined with the Newtown Action Alliance and gun violence advocates from across the nation in Washington D.C. to mark the approaching 10 year anniversary of the Sandy Hook massacre.

They bravely shared their pain from losing loved ones to gun violence. Many were survivors themselves. A room filled with courage, resilience, and strength. The only way to honor them is with action.

It’s time to end legacy admissions. Each year thousands of students are admitted to colleges around the nation only because their parents went there.

Legacy admissions are back-door discriminatory policies that overwhelmingly advantage wealthy, white students over everyone else.

Earlier this year, Congressman Jimmy Gomez and I joined other dads to launch the Congressional Dads Caucus to push for progress on issues like paid leave and affordable childcare.

Comprehensive, common-sense immigration reform is a priority for House Democrats. The Equal Citizenship for Children Act amends the Child Citizenship Act (CCA) to keep families together and automatically provide citizenship to eligible individuals previously excluded by the CCA. I’m proud to join Congresswoman Clarke in introducing this bill and taking us one step closer to immigration reform that makes sense for everyone who lives in our country.

Countless lives were lost between the continents, carrying with them knowledge, traditions and culture. On plantations across the U.S., our history went unrecorded and our graves unmarked.
